line_why: The carrier, coming at the camera nearly bow on, slowly yaws its bow to the right so the doodle's slab turns from a foreshortened front view into a long diagonal with the near side and underside showing; frame 45 is where that diagonal first reads. Frames 0-24 creep round 2 degrees during the approach, 27-42 build the swing, 46-49 carry it on.
